methods.name: ReadASAP2FileAndHexFile
methods.description: ReadASAP2FileAndHexFile Method (asap2FileName, hexFileName) Read an Asap2 file and a HEX file and create an Asap2 project with a dataset. If the address ranges of the HEX file don't fit to the Asap2 file the asap2 project will be generated but without a dataset. HEX file without code: Reading a HEX file without code depends on the global Inca user option "Check dataset code". If set to "Yes" only HEX files containing code and data will create a dataset. If set to "No" also HEX files without code will create a dataset. The created Asap2 project has the same name as the Asap2 file without file extension. If an Asap2 project with this name is already available an index will be appended to it.  Parameters  asap2FileName ( String )  The full path name of the Asap2 file to be read The full path name consists of "Drive Nr"\"Folder Hierarchy"\"Asap2FileName"  hexFileName ( String )  The full path name of the HEX file to be read. The full path name consists of "Drive Nr"\"Folder Hierarchy"\"HEXFileName"  Return Value  The new created Asap2 project or null if an error occurs Possible reasons for an error: No space left on the drive containing the database. Invalid file name specified.

The method will force a commit for the database if enabled  Parameters  dev ( HWDeviceDescription )  The hardware device description which corresponding hardware device is to be added.  sys ( HWSystem )  the hardware system being part of this hardware configuration

methods.name: GetState
methods.description: GetState Method (aParameterString) New interface INCA >= V7.2.3 to get current value(s) of an INCA state.  Similar to GetOption(), the desired state can be specified by using a parameter string with following structure:  "MODULE: aModuleName; DEVICENAME: aDeviceName; STATENAME: aStateName"  Example: "MODULE: HWC; DEVICENAME: ETK test device:1; STATENAME: BaudRate"  Remark: for most options/states it is mandatory that an Experiment is opened to get the value.  Parameters  aParameterString ( String )  String containing the info which Option of which INCA module shall return its current value(s)  Return Value  Returned string will represent the value of the addressed state. If a value list shall be returned, a ; is used as separator.  If State is not available or invalid ParameterStrig was sent, an API Error is returned.

methods.name: FlashHexFileWithControlFlow
methods.description: FlashHexFileWithControlFlow Method (fileName, controlFlow) Flash the contents of the hexfile to a target by using a specified control string. The hex file must be created using the method CreateHexFileForReferencePageAndCode() or CreateHexFileForWorkPageAndCode(). The controlFlow must be a string which contains the rules for flashing. The control string was typically build by the PROF toolbox in a user dialog. The controlFlow depends on the used target. A sample could be get by reading the target.log file after flashing with the tool. Getting the control flow: 1. Flash from the experiment. 2. To select a HEX file, choose “Hardware” - “Manage memory pages”. On the “Enhanced” tab, select the “Flash programming” action and apply it to “Data: ECU flash”. 3. Important: Select the desired flash parameters in Prof and flash the ECU. 4. Via the text editor, open the file under … ETAS\LogFiles\ProcessLogsV2\TGTSVR.log 5. Look for the entry  StorePermanentlyToTarget . 6. For example, the following entry is displayed: “StorePermanentlyToTarget(KWP2000:1, C:\APPLIK~1\PROJEKTE\MS6_\P0516500.HEX seed2key 3 prog convert C:\ETASDATA\PROF2.1\MS6\ms6)” 7. Enter the parameters into the Tool-API command as follows: INVOKE (Device_ID, 'FlashHexFileWithControlFlow', 'C:\APPLIK~1\PROJEKTE\MS6_\P0516500.HEX', 'seed2key 3 prog convert C:\ETASDATA\PROF2.1\MS6\ms6') - In the path of the HEX file, the DOS convention is not necessary. - In the path to the Prof control flow, the DOS convention is absolutely necessary, e.g. the path must not contain any spaces. Note on automatisation: The „PROF Control flow monitor“ must be closed manually at the end of the programming. (It is not possible to automatise this step). Workaround: change the  DEFAULT_SCREEN_LAYOUT (1) Mode  from 0 to 1 in the ProF-configuration The ProF-configuration is not allowed to contain the command "WAIT_FOR_KEY(-1)". This expects a manual key press. Parameters  fileName ( String )  describe the name and path for the file to create  controlFlow ( String )  describe how to flash a target.  Return Value  a boolean representing the success of the operation

methods.name: FlashHexFileWithControlFlowOnFlashPort
methods.description: FlashHexFileWithControlFlowOnFlashPort Method (fileName, controlFlow, flashPort) Flash the contents of the hexfile to a target by using a specified control string. The hex file must be created using the method CreateHexFileForReferencePageAndCode() or CreateHexFileForWorkPageAndCode(). The controlFlow must be a string which contains the rules for flashing. The control string was typically build by the PROF toolbox in a user dialog. The controlFlow depends on the used target. A sample could be get by reading the target.log file after flashing with the tool. Getting the control flow: see description of FlashHexFileWithControlFlow(...) The additional parameter String flashPort must be a name of an available flash port (use GetSupportedFlashPortNames() to get them) The current flash port defined in the HWC is ignored when using this interface. This method is implemented for INCA 5.4. The method will not operate in former versions.  Getting the control flow: 1. Flash from the experiment. 2. To select a HEX file, choose “Hardware” - “Manage memory pages”. On the “Enhanced” tab, select the “Flash programming” action and apply it to “Data: ECU flash”. 3. Important: Select the desired flash parameters in Prof and flash the ECU. 4. Via the text editor, open the file under … ETAS\LogFiles\ProcessLogsV2\TGTSVR.log 5. Look for the entry  StorePermanentlyToTarget . 6. For example, the following entry is displayed: “StorePermanentlyToTarget(KWP2000:1, C:\APPLIK~1\PROJEKTE\MS6_\P0516500.HEX seed2key 3 prog convert C:\ETASDATA\PROF2.1\MS6\ms6)” 7. Enter the parameters into the Tool-API command as follows: INVOKE (Device_ID, 'FlashHexFileWithControlFlow', 'C:\APPLIK~1\PROJEKTE\MS6_\P0516500.HEX', 'seed2key 3 prog convert C:\ETASDATA\PROF2.1\MS6\ms6') - In the path of the HEX file, the DOS convention is not necessary. - In the path to the Prof control flow, the DOS convention is absolutely necessary, e.g. the path must not contain any spaces. Note on automatisation: The „PROF Control flow monitor“ must be closed manually at the end of the programming. (It is not possible to automatise this step). Workaround: change the  DEFAULT_SCREEN_LAYOUT (1) Mode  from 0 to 1 in the ProF-configuration The ProF-configuration is not allowed to contain the command "WAIT_FOR_KEY(-1)". This expects a manual key press. Parameters  fileName ( String )  describe the name and path for the file to create  controlFlow ( String )  describe how to flash a target.  flashPort ( String )  describe which flash port shall be used.  Return Value  a boolean representing the success of the operation

methods.name: DoChecksumCalculation
methods.description: DoChecksumCalculation Execute a checksum calculation on the current device. The checksum is calculated for all available pages for that the user option  Hardware / Verify checksum  is set to true. Afterwards the methods  CheckDataPagesConform()  and  CheckCodePageConform()  can be called to check whether the respective pages have equal checksums at host and target. methods.name: GetOption
methods.description: GetOption Method (aParameterString) New interface INCA >= V7.2.3 to get current value(s) of an INCA option.  The desired option can be specified by using a parameter string with following structure:  "MODULE: aModuleName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName"  Example: "MODULE: EXPERIMENT; OPTIONNAME: RecorderAddDefaultComment"  Some Module need additionally a DeviceName to get an option from desired device.  "MODULE: aModuleName; DEVICENAME: aDeviceName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName"  Example: "MODULE: HWC; DEVICENAME: ETK test device:1; OPTIONNAME: BaudRate"  Remark: for most options it is mandatory that an Experiment is opened to get the option value.    Parameters  aParameterString ( String )  String containing the info which Option of which INCA module shall return its current value(s)  Return Value  Returned string will represent the value of the addressed option. If a value list shall be returned, a ; is used as separator.  If Option is not available or invalid ParameterStrig was sent, an API Error is returned.    SetOption Method (aParameterString) New interface INCA >= V7.2.3 to set / change the value of an INCA option.  The desired option can be specified by using a parameter string with following structure:  "MODULE: aModuleName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName"; OPTIONVALUE: anOptionValue  Example: "MODULE: EXPERIMENT; OPTIONNAME: RecorderAddDefaultComment; OPTIONVALUE: true"  Remark: for most options it is mandatory that an Experiment is opened to get the option value.  Parameters  aParameterString ( String )  String containing the info which Option of which INCA module shall be changed by new value  Return Value  Returned true when action was done successful.  If Option is not available or invalid ParameterStrig was sent, an API Error is returned.

methods.name: RecorderAddDefaultComment
methods.description: GetOption Method (aParameterString) New interface INCA >= V7.2.3 to get current value(s) of an INCA option.  The desired option can be specified by using a parameter string with following structure:  "MODULE: aModuleName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName"  Example: "MODULE: EXPERIMENT; OPTIONNAME: RecorderAddDefaultComment"  Some Module need additionally a DeviceName to get an option from desired device.  "MODULE: aModuleName; DEVICENAME: aDeviceName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName"  Example: "MODULE: HWC; DEVICENAME: ETK test device:1; OPTIONNAME: BaudRate"  Remark: for most options it is mandatory that an Experiment is opened to get the option value.    Parameters  aParameterString ( String )  String containing the info which Option of which INCA module shall return its current value(s)  Return Value  Returned string will represent the value of the addressed option. If a value list shall be returned, a ; is used as separator.  If Option is not available or invalid ParameterStrig was sent, an API Error is returned.    SetOption Method (aParameterString) New interface INCA >= V7.2.3 to set / change the value of an INCA option.  The desired option can be specified by using a parameter string with following structure:  "MODULE: aModuleName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName"; OPTIONVALUE: anOptionValue  Example: "MODULE: EXPERIMENT; OPTIONNAME: RecorderAddDefaultComment; OPTIONVALUE: true"  Remark: for most options it is mandatory that an Experiment is opened to get the option value.  Parameters  aParameterString ( String )  String containing the info which Option of which INCA module shall be changed by new value  Return Value  Returned true when action was done successful.  If Option is not available or invalid ParameterStrig was sent, an API Error is returned.

methods.name: GetRecordingState
methods.description: GetRecordingState Method  Answer the current recording state if the recording is started by a API call. The state for the recording will be true while the data is recorded and/or written to the recording file. The state will switch to false after the recording file is completely written. If the recording was started by a user interface action instead of a API call the answer will only be true while the recording is active. The writting of the recording file is not included in this case.  Return Value  true if recording is on or data is written, otherwise return false

methods.name: GetGlobalMeasureStateIndex
methods.description: GetGlobalMeasureStateIndex Method  Answer a number representing the current measure state of the experiment. In case of an error answer -1. The method is available since INCA 3.1.3. Possible answers are: 0 -> 'SWITCHED_OFF' 1 -> 'STIMULATING' 2 -> 'MEASURING'  Return Value  an index for the global measure state or -1 on error.

methods.name: GetGlobalMeasureStateLabel
methods.description: GetGlobalMeasureStateLabel Method  Answer the text label for the current measure state of the experiment. In case of an error answer an empty string. The method is available since INCA 3.1.3. Possible answers are: "SWITCHED_OFF" "STIMULATING" "MEASURING" "UNDEFINED"  Return Value  an label for the global measure state or "" on error.

methods.name: GetActualRecordingTimeMs
methods.description: GetActualRecordingTimeMs Method  Answer the current time for recording. This time takes the start trigger and pre trigger time into account. While waiting for a start trigger the answer is zero.  Return Value  int The current recording time in ms.  - While waiting for a start trigger the answer is  not  zero. (INCA7.2.2)

methods.name: GetRemainingRecordingTimeMs
methods.description: GetRemainingRecordingTimeMs Method  Get the calculated remaining time for recording. The value is only valid if the data recording is in progress. While waiting for a start trigger the method returns zero.  Return Value  int The remaining recording time in ms.  - does not work correctly - While waiting for a start trigger the method returns  not  zero.

methods.name: RecordingTimeRemaining
methods.description: Not implemented interface. Please use GetRemainingRecordingTimeMs() instead.

methods.name: RecordingTimeActual
methods.description: Not implemented interface. Please use GetActualRecordingTimeMs() instead.

methods.name: EnableFULIAccess
methods.description: EnableFULIAccess(  string  aLabel,  ExperimentDevice  device ) Enable the FULI access for given device + Variable name The method is designed for INCA version V6.2 Do not use in former versions.  Parameters  aLabel ( String )  label for a measure or calibration element  device ( ExperimentDevice )  device for the specified label (should answer true when isFULISupported is called)  Return Value  true if the FULI Access could be enabled successful for label, otherwise false.  -  Work only with connected ES910 - Vor dem anmelden müssen die Größen entweder im Experiment vorhanden oder per API angemeldet werden. - Das Kommando " SwitchCalibrationAccessOff" und"SwitchCalibrationAccessOn" müssen verwendet werden. - Werden nur Messgrößen ausgewählt, so muss vor dem Verbinden mit ILink die Messdatenanzeige gestartet werden. Beispiel VBA: 'Verstellgrößen anmelden x = ON_EXP_ID.SwitchCalibrationAccessOff a = 0 i = 1 Do While a = 0 If Cells(i + 1, 1).Value = "" Then Exit Do Else Set y = ON_EXP_ID.GetCalibrationElementInDevice(Cells(i + 1, 1).Value, Device_Fuli_ID) Set y1 = y.GetValue x = ON_EXP_ID.EnableFULIAccess(Cells(i + 1, 1).Value, Device_Fuli_ID) i = i + 1 End If Loop 'Messgrößen anmelden a = 0 i = 1 Do While a = 0 If Cells(i + 1, 2).Value = "" Then Exit Do Else Set Z = ON_EXP_ID.GetMeasureElementInDevice(Cells(i + 1, 2).Value, Device_Fuli_ID) Set z1 = Z.GetValue x = ON_EXP_ID.EnableFULIAccess(Cells(i + 1, 2).Value, Device_Fuli_ID) i = i + 1 End If Loop x = ON_EXP_ID.SwitchCalibrationAccessOn x = Device_Fuli_ID.SwitchToWorkingPage x = ON_EXP_ID.StartMeasurement

methods.description: GetFormulaCoefficients Method  Answer an array containing the coefficients a, b, c, d, e, f, for the fractional rational function of the following type: (axx + bx + c) / (dxx + ex + f). Also in case of formulas which do not need all six parameters the array will contain them. The method is only useful when working with moebius formulas. This method is not available in versions of INCA before 3.2.  Return Value  array of formula parameters or null on error.  FormulaCoefficients Method  Answer an array containing the coefficients a, b, c, d, e, f, for the fractional rational function of the following type: (axx + bx + c) / (dxx + ex + f). Also in case of formulas which do not need all six parameters the array will contain them. The method is only useful when working with moebius formulas. This method is not available in versions of INCA before 3.2.  Return Value  array of formula parameters or null on error.

The argument is an array containing always all six coefficients. Setting new coefficients will not chnage the base type of the formula. Unnecessary entries will be ignored. Parameters  coeffs (array< Double >[]()[][])  array containing the six parameters for the rational function  Return Value  true on success, otherwise false.

methods.description: GetETASLogFilePath Method  Answer the file system path for the ETAS log files.  Return Value: a String

methods.name: GetDataBasePath
methods.description: GetDataBasePath Method  Get the default path name of the database.  Return Value:  a string containing the path of the current Inca database or Null on error  DBPfad = INVOKE(H,' GetDataBasePath ')

methods.name: WriteToMonitor
methods.description: WriteToMonitor Method (text) Write something into the tool monitor window.  Parameters: text ( String )  which should be printed into the monitor.  Return Value: true on success. Otherwise return false.

methods.name: WriteReadyToMonitor
methods.description: WriteReadyToMonitor Method  Write the language dependent ready string e.g.: '...Ready' to the monitor.  Return Value: true on success. Otherwise return false.

methods.name: WriteMonitorLogFileToPathUsingFileName
methods.description: WriteMonitorLogFileToPathUsingFileName Method (pathName, fileName) Save the contents of the monitor view to the specified file in the specified path. An already existing file will be overwritten.  Parameters:  pathName ( String )  specifies the destination path for the monitor contents file. The pathName must end with an path separator. The pathName must specify an existing path.  fileName ( String )  specifies the name of the file for the monitor contents file.  Return Value:  true on success. Otherwise return false. {boolean}

methods.name: WriteMonitorLogFileToPath
methods.description: WriteMonitorLogFileToPath Method (pathName) Save the contents of the monitor view to the default file in the specified path. An already existing monitor file will be overwritten.  Parameters:  pathName ( String )  specifies the destination path for the monitor contents file. The pathName must end with an path separator. The pathName must specify an existing path.  Return Value: true on success. Otherwise return false.

methods.name: ClearMonitor
methods.description: ClearMonitor Method  Remove the contents of the monitor window.  Return Value:  true on success. Otherwise return false.

methods.name: BringToFront
methods.description: BringToFront Method  Send the message "BringToFront" to the View. This should make the View the top most view of the desktop.  Return Value  true on success, otherwise false.  Does not work with INCA 7.2.2

methods.name: GetCurrentASAMMCD3Mode
methods.description: GetCurrentASAMMCD3Mode Method  The external asap3 exe can ask for the current setting of asap3 option 0 ... toolbox not installed 1 ... ASAP3 V2.1 standard (legacy) 2 ... ASAM-MCD 3MCD (new)  Return Value  the mode or -1 on error.

methods.name: GetRecordingFileFormats

methods.name: GetRecordingFileFormatsInternal
methods.description: GetRecordingFileFormatsInternal Method  Get all supported file formats for the recording properties.  If an error occurs return null.  Return Value  Array of strings with names of all possible file formats.

methods.name: GetPrimaryRecordingFormatID
methods.description: GetPrimaryRecordingFormatID Method  Returns the Identifier for the actually configured "Primary Recording Format" (example "mdf 3.0", "mdf 4.0").  Since INCA 7.0, INCA can write the recording data in additional formats apart from "mdf 3.0" (e.g. mdf 4.0).  See INCA user option: a) Ini File (inca.INI) Property: MdfFileType b) INCA DBBrowser Menu --> Options --> User Options --> Experiment --> Measure --> General --> MDF File Type

methods.name: GetPollingCycleTimeTS
methods.description: GetPollingCycleTimeTS Method Get a time in seconds. This is the target server data polling cycle time [s], default is 0,1s = 100ms Return Value  a double value

The desired option can be specified by using a parameter string with following structure:  "MODULE: aModuleName; OPTIONNAME: anOptionName; OPTIONVALUE: anOptionValue"  Examples:  "MODULE: EXPERIMENT; OPTIONNAME: RecorderAddDefaultComment; OPTIONVALUE: true"  "MODULE: USEROPTIONS; OPTIONNAME: [General]Maximizedwindows; OPTIONVALUE: false"  Remark:  For some options it is mandatory that an Experiment is opened to set the option value.  When using USEROPTIONS, any Experiment and other Editors must be closed.

methods.name: LockTool
methods.description: LockTool Method Prevent the user from closing the tool by displaying an additional confirmation box.   Return Value  true for successful locking, false on error

methods.name: UnlockTool
methods.description: UnlockTool Method  Remove the tool lock. The closing of the tool will behave normal.  Return Value  true for successful unlocking, false on error

methods.name: IsToolLocked
methods.description: IsToolLocked Method  Get the state of the lock flag for closing the tool. If the tool is locked an additional conformation box appears when trying to close the tool.  Return Value  a boolean for the current state of the lock flag

methods.name: LockDatabase
methods.description: LockDatabase Method  Disable the mechanism to change the current data base in the tool.  Return Value  true for successful locking, false on error

methods.name: UnlockDatabase
methods.description: UnlockDatabase Method  Enable the mechanism to change the current data base in the tool.  Return Value  true for successful unlocking, false on error

methods.name: IsDatabaseLocked
methods.description: IsDatabaseLocked Method  Get the state of the lock flag for the data base change. If the data base is locked no changing of the data base is possible. Even within the tool.  Return Value  a boolean for the current state of the lock flag

methods.name: LockExperiment
methods.description: LockExperiment Method  Prevent the user from closing the experiment by displaying an additional confirmation box.  Return Value  true for successful locking, false on error

methods.name: UnlockExperiment
methods.description: UnlockExperiment Method  Remove the experiment lock to enable the standard closing mechanism.  Return Value  true for successful unlocking, false on error

methods.name: IsExperimentLocked
methods.description: IsExperimentLocked Method  Get the state of the lock flag for closing the experiment. If the experiment is locked an additional conformation box appears when trying to close the experiment.  Return Value  a boolean for the current state of the lock flag

methods.name: SwitchCatchWalkbackOff
methods.description: SwitchCatchWalkbackOff Method  Switch the internal mode of the tool API to report walkbacks in the standard way. A walkback will be displayed in the standard tool behavior. The API request will not be answered in this case. In this case the client typically hangs up since he is waiting forever of the response. The default setting is switched off. The feature is available since procuct version  Method oes not work since INCA7.1.7

methods.name: SwitchCatchWalkbackOn
methods.description: SwitchCatchWalkbackOn Method  Switch the internal mode of the tool API to catch tool walkbacks. The walkback will be filed out in the log files directory '\Cebra\cebra.wkb'. The API request will be answered with an error (code:999). In this case the tool should be closed and restarted, since the internal state of the tool is unknown. The default setting is switched off. The feature is available since procuct version INCA 3.2.2  Method oes not work since INCA7.1.7

methods.name: GetToolErrorCode
methods.description: GetToolErrorCode Method  If a tool error code is available for this object answer the error code. If no tool error code is available answer 0. Create: (20.03.2002 12:15:15) Return Value  the tool error code or 0 if not available.

methods.name: IsToolErrorAvailable
methods.description: IsToolErrorAvailable Method  This method checks whether the the last API request to this object has caused an error.  Return Value  boolean

methods.name: GetToolErrorMessage
methods.description: GetToolErrorMessage Method  If a tool error code is available for this object answer the error message. If no tool error code is available answer an empty string. Return Value  the tool error message or an empty string if not available.
